messages:
Avery: Heads-up 1: launching a publisher preflight for the cloud storefronts (AWS/GCP/Azure). Need quick volunteers to confirm: SKU mapping, legal checklist, asset upload location, and minimal cross-account IAM. Goal: request staging publish by end of week.
Linh: I can do IAM + terraform examples. Will draft minimal perms for each cloud (read-only where possible).
Sam: Ill own SKU mapping + pricing tier text. Do we support hourly + monthly billing or just subscription?
Diego: Legal: I'll run the privacy + export-control matrix. Also need to see the third-party model attribution copy.
Avery: For billing let's stick to subscription for GA, add hourly as a "coming soon" note. Sam, can you include trial gating rules?
Sam: Yep. Proposed SKUs: RINF-SML, RINF-MED, RINF-ENT-TR. Trial SKU: RINF-ENT-30D (single-use). Any objections to that naming?
Diego: Prefer not to use "ENT" as a public SKU label. Suggest RINF-PRO-TR instead of ENT.
Linh: FYI infra notes: for AWS we'll request a cross-account role with AssumeRole + s3:GetObject. For GCP we need a service account with roles/storage.objectViewer + roles/compute.viewer. Azure needs a managed identity with Reader + Storage Blob Data Reader.
marketplace-bot: :pushpin: Template checklist added: https://redwood.internal/marketplace/checklists/preflight-template-v3.md
Avery: Where to upload assets (screenshots, logos, feature list)? Shared drive or publisher portal?
Sam: Upload master assets to /Shared/marketplace/publisher-uploads/1701190000, then we can push to publisher portal. I'll create a small README with image sizes.
Linh: IAM sample (AWS) to paste in publisher ticket:
```json
{
  "Version": "2012-10-17",
  "Statement": [
    {
      "Effect": "Allow",
      "Principal": {"AWS": "arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/RedwoodPublisher"},
      "Action": "sts:AssumeRole"
    }
  ]
}
```
Sam: Packaging note: include a "data residency" toggle in the SKU description if customer can choose region. Legal + Eng please confirm allowed regions.
Diego: I'll confirm allowed regions and whether the listing copy needs a mandatory data-handling paragraph.
Avery: Action list:
- Avery: create shared folder + manifest template (today)
- Sam: SKU spreadsheet + pricing + README for assets (24h)
- Linh: IAM snippets for all 3 clouds + test creds process (48h)
- Diego: legal checklist + terms note (48h)
marketplace-bot: :warning: Reminder: compliance requires a signed privacy_manifest.pdf in the folder before staging request.
Sam: Proposed CTAs: "Start free trial" for trial SKU, "Contact sales" for pro-tier. Thoughts?
Diego: Fine. Also add checkbox: "third-party model license" and "privacy & retention".
Linh: Small implementation note: for GCP publisher integration we need the publisher project to enable the Cloud Resource Manager API; will add to README.
Avery: Can we do a 20-min sync tomorrow 9:00 AM PT to check progress?
Sam: Works for me.
Diego: I'll join.
Linh: On calendar.
Avery: Thanks all 680 I'll upload the manifest and share the folder link here once ready.
